name: Swirl Together (art therapy fluid sim sandbox)

mentions.name: Swirl Together (art therapy fluid sim sandbox)
mentions.description: This app is an art therapy sandbox built on Pavel Dobryakov's fluid sim, letting users play with soothing fluid art in the browser for free. It is nearly finished, slated for release on Steam, and will be released fully open source on GitHub shortly after. The builder has used it personally over the years, finding it soothing, and hopes others find it soothing and beneficial.
